name: Gome
source:
Likes: Eating everything she can find, teasing people.

Gome is a white whale that grants the wishes of those who can see her and an animal from the world of demons. However, Gome does actually not grant any wishes and has no magic, she spends her time eating other people's food... By her nature, Gome is supposed to stay hidden, living secretly around the dormitory, but she spends her time going to the city to buy porn mags and going to the school from time to time, before suddenly and violently disappearing due to [url=/c38917]Reika[/url].

She speaks in a calm and jaded way but changes her tone and adopts a quick way of speaking when she's in danger...

"Is that your wish?"
